empty.title: No pending request

upsell.unavailable: The trial is not available on this account.

counterSheet.noSlots: No slot available that day. Try another day.

counterSheet.errorExpired: The request expired before the proposal was sent.

barbers.label: Barber
barbers.revenueHint: The owner decides, barber by barber. By default a barber does not see amounts.

empty.title: Nothing planned today
empty.description: No appointment and no blocked time. Create a booking for a client who calls, or block a slot.
empty.noBarbersDescription: The agenda fills up per chair: add a professional to the team first.

grid.label: Agenda grid
grid.instructions: Drag an appointment to move it. On mobile, long-press then drag — or use “Move” in the sheet.

sheet.title: Appointment
sheet.noShowHint: Recorded, no restriction for the client.
sheet.cancelBody: The client is notified immediately and can book another slot.

create.title: New appointment
create.description: For a client who calls — confirmed right away.

create.hint: The client gets a confirmation if they have an email.
create.noService: No active service at this establishment.

block.description: Break, leave, training — the slot can no longer be booked.
block.seriesHint: This block is part of a weekly series.

block.overlapsAppointments_other: {{count}} appointments fall in this range within the displayed period: they stay in place, tell the clients.

conflict.title: This slot is already taken

conflict.reasonPlaceholder: Loyal client, the apprentice does the shampoo…
conflict.forceHint: The overlap will be recorded: who, when, why.
conflict.cannotForce: Only the owner and a manager can force an overlap.
conflict.blockCannotForce: Blocked time cannot be forced: remove it or pick another slot.

toast.moved: Appointment moved. The client is notified.
toast.noShow: No-show recorded, no restriction for the client.
toast.cancelled: Booking cancelled. The client is notified.

catalog.title: Services
catalog.subtitle: What your shop offers, and who performs it.

empty.title: Your catalogue is empty
empty.description: One service, one duration, one price: that is what makes your profile bookable.

emptyArchived.title: No archived service
emptyArchived.description: Services taken out of the catalogue appear here, with their history intact.

sheet.name: Name
sheet.descriptionHint: Optional. What the customer reads before booking.

sheet.draftNotice: You are creating this service without a price: it stays out of the catalogue until the owner prices it.

estimate.title: What the announced duration changes

estimate.tooFewSamples_other: FadeUp has measured {{count}} services — not enough to count yet. The customer sees exactly the duration you announce here.

estimate.blended_other: FadeUp has measured {{count}} services: what the customer sees comes {{percent}}% from your announced duration, the rest from the observed average.
estimate.observedOnly: FadeUp has measured {{count}} services: the customer now sees the observed average, not the announced duration.

assign.title: Who performs this service
assign.hint: Nobody ticked: the whole team performs it.
assign.empty: No chair in this shop yet. Invite a barber from the Team screen.

archive.title: Archive this service?
archive.body: It leaves the catalogue and every public surface. Past appointments keep it.

remove.title: Delete this service?
remove.body: Permanent. Possible only because no appointment, queue entry or post refers to it.

errors.priceForbidden: Pricing is reserved to the owner and the manager. Your change was not saved.
errors.hasHistory: This service has history: archive it instead of deleting it.
errors.durationRequired: A service needs a duration above zero.

errors.archived: This service is archived. Restore it before editing.

badge.verifiedHint: Has a FadeUp identity and at least one service delivered at your shop.
